'''TransTech Droidworks''' was a corporation owned by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] on [[Loken III]], and although the factory had only a modest capacity for [[Droid/Legends|droid]] production, it was still pressed into service creating [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] led a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] attack on the facility during the war.
